rows.title: Amend goes through a confirmation page, then opens the amend review, in animals and plants
rows.detail: A trader who amends a submitted notification is asked to confirm first, on a page of its own, and then lands straight on that notification's review page, where every answer and its Change link sit together. Today Amend on a notification's card starts the amendment at once and lands on the overview hub, one step short of the review; the plants journey does the same, and a notification's view page offers no way to amend at all. After this change one confirmation page stands in front of every way into an amendment: 'Amend this notification' on the view page and Amend on the card both open it, confirming is a form post that starts the amendment and lands on the review, and backing out leaves the notification submitted and untouched. An amendment that cannot start, because the reference is unknown or the notification is not submitted, changes nothing and returns the trader to the set's own notification list. The plants journey gets the same page and lands on its own review page. The performance suite's amendment journey follows the new landing.
acceptanceCriteria: 'Amend this notification' on a submitted notification's view page, and Amend on its card in the set's notification list, open a page whose title and level-1 heading are 'Amend notification' and which asks 'Are you sure you want to change this notification?', and the notification still shows as submitted until the trader confirms (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-046, prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-047, prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-051; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-107, prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-108; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p12-181; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-078)

'Yes, continue' on the amend confirmation page is a button that submits the page's form and starts the amendment, and the trader lands on that notification's review page showing it is being amended (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-048, prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-081; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-110, prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-124; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-081)

'No, go back' on the amend confirmation page is a link-styled control that returns to the notification's view page with the notification still submitted and nothing changed, and the page's Back link goes to the view page too (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-048; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-110; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-079)

With JavaScript turned off, choosing Amend on the view page or on the card opens the amend confirmation page, and its 'Yes, continue' still starts the amendment (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-075, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-076)

Opening or posting a notification's amend address when its reference is unknown, or when the notification is a draft, a completed one, or one already being amended, changes nothing and returns the trader, with no message, to the set's own notification list (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-075; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-129; repo:backend repo-backend-p2-092, repo-backend-p2-093; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-101, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-102)

In the high-risk plants frontend, Amend on a submitted plants notification's card and on its view page open the same confirmation page, with the same title, heading, question, 'Yes, continue' and 'No, go back'; 'Yes, continue' lands on plants' own review page for that notification, and a refused amend returns to plants' own notification list with no message (repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p3-115; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-057)

On the workspace stack the performance suite's amendment journey passes with Amend landing on the notification's amend review: its amendment-started check expects the review page, it still edits the origin page, and both its endings still pass, either cancelling at the cancel-amendment page to land on the view page whose address carries ?cancelled=1, or resubmitting through the review and the declaration (repo:perftests repo-perftests-p1-071, repo-perftests-p1-072, repo-perftests-p1-074; ruling:sam-2026-10-07 ruling-sam-2026-10-07-p1-002)

With the service in Welsh, the amend confirmation page's title, heading, question and controls show Welsh text, in animals and in plants (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p3-089; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p3-114)
rows.gate: Look at the amend confirmation page in animals and plants, and at the card's Amend now a link to it: the cancel-amendment page and the germinal set's copies follow the same page pattern.
rows.notes: Pass 2 combines the confirmation page (req-1391, req-1392), where confirming lands (req-1394), the guard (req-1487) and the performance-suite check (req-1877): one route, one page, one review and one ladder. c-190 and c-310 settle that the confirmation is a page carrying the pop-up's wording and that the card's Amend goes through it; c-189 that confirming is a form post; c-191 and c-225 that the landing is the review and the k6 check moves with it; c-198 that a refused amend goes to the set's own list. The dialog half of req-1391 and req-1392 is req-1393's, in the blocked pop-up row. The view page's 'Amend this notification' comes from inc-112 on the overview-and-review branch, which this row needs landed; the card's Amend lives in each frontend's dashboard feature, which the animals-dashboard theme also changes. Welsh for the delete and cancel-amendment strings is req-1480, carried by the delete page row. rows.title: The cancel-amendment page is one question and two controls, and returns to the submitted notification with no banner, in animals and plants
rows.detail: Cancelling an amendment is confirmed on a short page: a question as its heading, no explanation, a button to confirm and a plain link back. Today the page asks 'Cancel this amendment?', explains that the changes will be discarded, offers a secondary button back to the notification, and carries the notification's status tag, reference and a Back link above the heading; the restored notification then opens with a success banner. After this change the page carries the question and its two controls alone, the restored notification's view shows no banner although its address still marks the cancellation, and opening the page for a notification nobody is amending returns the trader to the set's own notification list. Plants' cancel-amendment page changes the same way in the same increment.
acceptanceCriteria: The cancel-amendment page's title and level-1 heading are 'Are you sure you want to cancel this amendment?', with no caption above the heading (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-052; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-125; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-085; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-080)

The whole content of the cancel-amendment page is its heading, the button 'Yes, cancel amendment' and a link-styled 'Go back' (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-054, prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-055; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-085; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-080)

'Go back' returns the trader to the notification's view, which is the amend review while an amendment is in progress, and leaves the amendment and its changed answers in place (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p1-029, prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-054; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p3-083, repo-frontend-p3-125; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-084)

'Cancel amend' beside Continue on the amend review, 'Cancel amend' in the amend status bar and 'Cancel amendment' on the notification's card all reach the page at the notification's own cancel-amendment address, which shows its heading as the first thing under the service header, with no status tag, reference or Back link above it (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-056; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p3-078, repo-frontend-p3-138; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p3-102, repo-plantsfrontend-p3-110; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-086)

After 'Yes, cancel amendment' the trader lands on the notification's view page, read only and showing it submitted with its submitted answers, its address carrying ?cancelled=1 and no banner above the page heading (repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p3-112, repo-plantsfrontend-p3-118; repo:tests repo-tests-p3-080; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-101; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-088)

Opening the cancel-amendment address, or posting to it, for a notification that is not being amended, a submitted one included, changes nothing and returns the trader, with no message, to the set's own notification list (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-085; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-128; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p3-079, repo-frontend-p3-087; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-101, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-102)

In the high-risk plants frontend the cancel-amendment page has the same title and heading, the same two controls and nothing else, with 'Go back' returning to plants' check answers view; after 'Yes, cancel amendment' plants' view shows the restored submitted notification with no banner and its address carries ?cancelled=1; and opening or posting it for a plants notification that is not being amended returns to plants' own notification list with no message (repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p3-104, repo-plantsfrontend-p3-105, repo-plantsfrontend-p3-109, repo-plantsfrontend-p3-112; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-059)

With the service in Welsh, the cancel-amendment page's heading, 'Yes, cancel amendment' and 'Go back' show Welsh text, in animals and in plants (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p3-089; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p3-114)

rows.title: Copy as new carries over the trade answers and clears the shipment answers, from the submitted version
rows.detail: A copy of a notification keeps the answers that describe the trade — the origin, the internal reference number, what is being imported with its species, the main reason for import and its follow-ups, the additional animal details, the parties and the CPH number — and leaves the answers that belong to one shipment to be given again: how many animals and packages, the animal identifiers, the arrival, the transit countries, the transporter, the documents and the contact address. Today the record and the pages disagree: the record clears the internal reference, the species, the unweaned answer and the exit date, while the copy's overview shows counts, identification, arrival, transit, transport and contact address as Complete because the whole answer payload is copied across. After this change a copy keeps and clears the same list in the record and on the pages alike, a certified-for answer the set no longer offers is mapped to one it does, and copying a notification part-way through an amendment copies its submitted version rather than the edits in progress. The plants journey has no copy action, so plants does not change.
acceptanceCriteria: A copy's origin of the import comes back with the source notification's internal reference number, and the copy's review page shows it (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-063; repo:backend repo-backend-p2-048)

A copy's commodity pages come back with the source's commodity, its commodity selections and its selected species, and the copy carries the same notification type, worked out from the copied answers where it is not stored (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-064, prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-071; repo:backend repo-backend-p2-049, repo-backend-p2-050; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-101)

A copy's import reason pages come back with the main reason for import and its follow-ups: the internal market purpose, the transhipment destination country, the transit exit border control post, the transit destination country, and the temporary admission exit date and port of exit (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-065; repo:backend repo-backend-p2-053, repo-backend-p2-059, repo-backend-p2-062; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-101)

A copy's additional details come back with what the animals are certified for, whether unweaned animals are included and the storage temperature (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-066; repo:backend repo-backend-p2-054; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-101)

On the workspace stack, copying a live-animals notification stored through the backend API with certified-for 'Breeding' or 'Breeding and/or production' gives a copy certified for 'Further keeping'; 'Slaughter' stays 'Slaughter'; and any other value the set does not offer gives 'Further keeping' (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-070)

A copy's overview shows Commodity details as To do, its Animals total reads 0 and its Packages or boxes total shows no figure (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-068; repo:backend repo-backend-p2-051; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-102)

A copy's overview shows Identification details, Arrival details, Transport details and Contact address as To do (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-068; repo:backend repo-backend-p2-052, repo-backend-p2-060, repo-backend-p2-061; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-101)
A copy's transit countries page comes back with no country chosen (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-068; trace:e2e trace-e2e-p13-109)

Copying a notification that is being amended copies its submitted version: an answer changed during the amendment and not yet resubmitted does not appear on the copy, and the submitted answer does (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-058, prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-059; repo:backend repo-backend-p2-066)
rows.notes: c-196 settles what a copy carries, in the record and on the pages alike, and c-197 that an amendment in progress is copied from its submitted version. Pass 1 had two slices, what a copy keeps (req-1424, req-1425, req-1428, req-1429, req-1430) and what it clears (req-1426, req-1427, req-1432 to req-1435); pass 2 merges them with copying the submitted version (req-1437), because each changes the same backend copy mapping and the frontend's stub persistence copy and all are proven by copying one full notification and reading the copy. What a copy already keeps or clears correctly (req-1423, req-1431, req-1436) stays as it is. The copy must clear the cleared answers from the copied answer payload as well as from the record, so the overview's task statuses follow. The certified-for mapping criterion is written for the workspace stack alone, the only place a notification with a retired value can be stored through the backend API. The germinal halves (req-1879, req-1880) are the germinal row's. Plants has no copy action (req-2003 and req-2055 are out of scope), so there is no plants half. rows.title: A stale Copy as new from the view page returns to the view page and says the notification has been updated
rows.detail: Copy as new is checked against the version of the notification the trader was looking at, so a copy of something that has changed since is refused and the trader is told. Started from the notification list this works; started from the notification's view page the trader is sent to an address no page answers. After this change a refused copy returns the trader to where they started, the list or the notification's view page, tells them the notification has been updated, and copies nothing.
acceptanceCriteria: When the notification changed after the trader opened its view page, for instance because it was amended in another tab, Copy as new on that view page copies nothing and returns the trader to the notification's view page showing 'The notification has been updated' (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p3-074, repo-frontend-p3-075, repo-frontend-p3-075-m1; repo:backend repo-backend-p2-040)

When the notification changed after the trader opened the set's notification list, Copy as new on its card copies nothing and returns the trader to that list showing 'The notification has been updated' (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p3-074; repo:backend repo-backend-p2-035, repo-backend-p2-040)
After a refused copy, no new draft appears in the set's notification list (repo:backend repo-backend-p2-040, repo-backend-p2-040-m1; repo:tests repo-tests-p4-106)
rows.notes: Kept apart from the copy carry-over row: a frontend redirect fix with its own set-up, two tabs and a stale version, and nothing to do with what a copy carries. Plants has no copy action, so there is no plants half. The view page's Copy as new control comes from inc-112 on the overview-and-review branch, which this row needs landed. Unchanged in substance by this re-distil.

rows.title: The delete confirmation page identifies the notification in a summary, with shorter wording and a plain link back, in animals and plants
rows.detail: Before deleting, the trader is shown which notification they are about to delete — its reference, what is in it, how many and where it came from — and the page's wording and controls are shorter, with a plain link back to the notification. Today the page carries a heading, one sentence and two buttons, shows the notification's status tag and reference above the heading, and its way back goes to the set's notification list. After this change the page shows the summary list, the new sentence, warning and buttons, and both the Back link and the way back return to the notification's view page. Plants' delete page changes in the same increment, filled with plants' own commodity, origin and quantity, and plants' own checks follow it. In the live-animals set the Number row counts animals; the germinal set's packages count is its own increment.
acceptanceCriteria: The delete confirmation page shows a GOV.UK summary list with the rows 'Reference number', 'Commodity', 'Number' and 'Origin', the Origin row giving the notification's country of origin (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-173, prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-176; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-138; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-107, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-111)

In the animals sets the Commodity row lists each commodity's common name with its species' Latin names in brackets, comma-separated, such as 'Sheep (Ovis Aries), Goat (Capra Hircus)', and for other live mammals it gives each species' common name (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-174; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-139; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-083)

For a live-animals notification the Number row shows the notification's total number of animals (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-175; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-057)

A summary row the notification has no value for shows what the set's notification list shows for that notification, and 'Not applicable' when the list has nothing either (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-177; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-061)

Below the summary the page says 'Confirm that you want to delete this notification.' (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-178; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-140; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-108)

The page warns 'This action cannot be undone.' (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-178; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-141; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-108)
The page's red warning button reads 'Yes, delete' (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-179; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-109)

The page's button group holds the red warning button 'Yes, delete' and, beside it, a plain link reading 'No, cancel' (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-180; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-142; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-110)

The page's Back link and its 'No, cancel' link both return the trader to the notification's view page, and the notification is still there (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-168, prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-170, prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-171; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-143; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-110)

The page shows its heading as the first thing under the service header, with no status tag or reference above it; the summary list is what identifies the notification (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-171; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p3-094-m1; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-111)

In the high-risk plants frontend the delete page shows the same four summary rows, filled with the plants notification's reference, its commodity as plants names it, its quantity and its country of origin, the same sentence, warning, 'Yes, delete' and 'No, cancel', no status tag or reference above the heading, and Back and 'No, cancel' both returning to plants' check answers view (repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p3-086, repo-plantsfrontend-p3-087, repo-plantsfrontend-p3-089, repo-plantsfrontend-p3-091; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-061)

With the service in Welsh, every new or changed string on the delete page, the cancel-amendment page, the amend confirmation page and the notification's view page shows Welsh text of the same shape, in animals and in plants (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p3-089, repo-frontend-p3-104; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p3-096, repo-plantsfrontend-p3-114)

The plants frontend's own checks for delete and cancel amendment assert the changed pages: the delete page's summary, wording, 'Yes, delete', 'No, cancel' and Back link to the view page, and the cancel-amendment page's heading, its two controls alone and 'Go back'; they still assert ?deleted=1, ?cancelled=1, the restored submitted notification and no serious or critical accessibility violations, and they cover deleting a submitted and an amending plants notification and the cancel-amendment page's return to plants' own list for a notification that is not being amended (repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p3-097 to repo-plantsfrontend-p3-101, repo-plantsfrontend-p3-116, repo-plantsfrontend-p3-119)

rows.title: The deletion message reads 'Notification has been deleted' on each set's own list, and deleting an amending notification is proven
rows.detail: After a delete the trader lands on the set's own notification list, whose address marks the deletion so the list shows the message straight away. The message is worded for a page that does not know the deleted notification's reference, so it names none. Deleting a notification part-way through an amendment already works, but nothing proves it, and nothing proves what the amend, cancel-amendment, copy and delete addresses do for a notification that cannot take that action. After this change both the live animals list and plants' own list carry the new message, and the end-to-end suite proves deleting an amending notification and each of those guards, keeping its smoke-tagged cancel and delete cases. The plants wording goes in plants' own list copy, leaving the wording its other pages share as it is.
acceptanceCriteria: After 'Yes, delete', the live animals notification list, opened at ?deleted=1, shows a success message reading 'Notification has been deleted' (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-183; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-145; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-101)

In the high-risk plants frontend, plants' own notification list opened at ?deleted=1 after a delete shows a success message reading 'Notification has been deleted' (repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p3-094; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-070)

A notification being amended can be deleted from the amend review's Delete button: after 'Yes, delete' it is no longer in the set's notification list, in animals and in plants (repo:backend repo-backend-p3-034; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p3-091; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p3-085; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-118)
The backend's soft-delete endpoint describes itself as deleting draft, submitted and amending notifications (repo:backend repo-backend-p3-034, repo-backend-p3-035)

The end-to-end suite on the workspace stack proves that an amending notification can be deleted, and that amend, cancel amendment, copy as new and delete for a notification that cannot take that action return the trader to the set's own notification list with no message; it still asserts ?cancelled=1 on the cancel-amendment redirect and ?deleted=1 on the delete redirect, and its smoke-tagged cancel-amendment and delete cases still run in the smoke suite against the new wording and landings (repo:tests repo-tests-p3-094 to repo-tests-p3-096, repo-tests-p3-099, repo-tests-p3-209, repo-tests-p3-209-m1; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p3-135-m1)

On plants' list a submitted notification's card still offers the actions it offers today, and an amending one still offers 'Cancel amendment', after the deletion message changes (repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p3-094; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-070)
With the service in Welsh, the deletion message shows Welsh text on each set's own list and in plants (repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p3-096; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p3-104)

rows.title: Amend, cancel amendment, copy as new and delete for germinal products notifications
rows.detail: A submitted germinal products notification is managed on the germinal set's own copies of the amend, cancel-amendment, notification actions and delete pages, taken from the live-animals ones once this programme has changed them. The germinal delete page counts packages where live animals count animals, and a copy of a germinal notification stays a germinal notification with its certified-for answer.
acceptanceCriteria: A submitted germinal products notification offers Amend, Cancel amendment, Copy as new and Delete through the germinal set's own pages, with the same confirmation pages, wording and destinations as a live-animals notification, and its guards and its delete land on the germinal set's own notification list (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-006, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-014, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-110)

On the germinal products delete page the Number row shows the notification's total number of packages (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-175; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-057)

Copying a germinal products notification makes a germinal products draft with a new reference that opens in the germinal set and not in the live-animals set, and copying a live-animals notification still makes a live-animals draft (repo:backend repo-backend-p2-034; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-027, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-029, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-030, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-031)
A copy of a germinal products notification is certified for 'Germinal products' (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-070; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-019)

rows.title: Waiting on design: the amend and cancel-amendment confirmations as dialogs over the page
rows.detail: The amend and cancel-amendment confirmations are drawn as dialogs over the page the trader is already on. GOV.UK Frontend has no modal dialog, the Ministry of Justice's one is not accepted because it is experimental and documents no fallback without JavaScript, and no increment writes custom JavaScript to copy a prototype, so the confirmations are built now as pages of their own. This increment would add the dialogs over those pages in both animals sets and in plants, and is built only if design makes the case for them; otherwise it is dropped.
acceptanceCriteria: With JavaScript, 'Amend this notification' and 'Cancel amend' open their confirmations as dialogs over the current page instead of opening the confirmation pages, each hidden until opened, announced as a modal dialog named by its heading, the amend dialog also described by its question, with a Close button announced as 'Close' and an overlay behind it (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p1-026, prototype-dr2-1-source-p1-029, prototype-dr2-1-source-p1-030, prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-049, prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-050, prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-056; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p12-183, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-059, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-060, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-061)

Close, the overlay and the dialog's 'No, go back' or 'Go back' all dismiss the dialog without acting and leave the trader on the page they were on, with the notification unchanged (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-054, prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-055; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-083, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-084)

With JavaScript turned off, the same controls reach the amend and cancel-amendment confirmation pages and those pages work as they do without this increment (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-075, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-076, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-077)
The same dialogs and the same fallback apply in the high-risk plants frontend (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-084)
openQuestions: Design question 9 (design must answer): are the amend and cancel-amendment dialogs built at all, and if so with which tested government component? Expected answer: not built, and this row is then dropped. Built only if design makes a strong case; the Ministry of Justice's modal dialog is not accepted.
rows.notes: Draft for merging into inc-195, which already covers req-1393; the combiner keeps its id and its waiting-on-design theme. req-1393 still carries its blocker, design question 9, so the row stays blocked with no safe default to build: the pages it would enhance are built by the amend and cancel-amendment rows, and nobody can build a dialog without an accepted component. Depends on those rows, on the amend status bar row on the journey-foundation branch and on the germinal copies, whose pages it would enhance. A 27 October reading found no dialog in either frontend, so the block still applies.

rows.title: A notification needing action can be amended, copied and deleted as a submitted one can
rows.detail: A notification whose status reads 'Submitted action required' offers the trader the same actions as a submitted one, and every action must accept it, or the trader is refused on the very notification that needs their attention. Amending it opens its amendment and keeps its submitted answers aside; cancelling that amendment puts them back, and the status that follows from them; resubmitting records whatever status the outstanding items give at that moment; Copy as new copies it into a new draft; and Delete removes it and publishes its deletion. The animals sets only: the plants journey has no action-required status.
acceptanceCriteria: On the view of a notification showing 'Submitted action required', 'Amend this notification' and the amend confirmation start its amendment, as they do for a submitted one, and its submitted answers are kept aside unchanged (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-096; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-008, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-012; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-070, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-071)

Cancelling that amendment returns the trader to the notification's view showing 'Submitted action required' and its submitted answers, unchanged (prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-134; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-071)

Resubmitting that amendment with the outstanding document now uploaded and nothing else outstanding shows the notification as 'Submitted', and resubmitting it with items still outstanding shows it as 'Submitted action required' (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-096; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-071)

'Copy as new' on a notification showing 'Submitted action required' makes a new draft carrying over the same answers a copy of a submitted one carries (prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-134; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-012)

'Delete' on a notification showing 'Submitted action required' removes it from the set's own notification list with the deletion message, and the backend publishes its submission-deleted event (repo:backend repo-backend-p3-034; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-012; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-070)
rows.notes: Draft for merging into inc-201, which already covers req-2113; the combiner keeps its id and its manage-notifications theme.
